name: 30814 · Harlem, GA
findings: ZIP 30814 (Harlem) has 20 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (83% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30814 (Harlem) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
